retry_rule: retry unchanged configuration and identical seed after atomic-write cleanup
fallback_rule: method-specific prespecified identity/raw fallback with explicit status; never substitute guessed values
missing_data_handling: no imputation of missing job endpoints; incomplete pairs block primary inference until completion or versioned exclusion sensitivity
failed_job_handling: retain failed job row, error class, traceback digest, attempt count and last durable checkpoint
overwrite_rule: no overwrite of committed artifact with a different hash
smoke_rule: smoke failures may be rerun unchanged but cannot enter scientific evidence
